html: Well, it’s Sunday Jun 28th and I have three blog talk radio interviews before I start packing for my week in Roswell, New Mexico for the annual UFO convention. While I’m in town I’ll do a television interview on KBIM TV, give a lecture on my best selling Rho Agenda series, and do several days of book signings at the International UFO Museum. I don’t expect to have much time to update my blog this week but as soon as I can work it into my schedule, I’ll bring everyone up to date.
